a.lede: The spy who targeted NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang was reportedly a recruit by China's version of the CIA. US officials say Huang was romantically involved with her.
a.title: China's main intelligence agency reportedly recruited the spy who targeted NVIDIA's CEO

b.lede: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.
b.title: Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair
